title: Deep Hash Embedding plus structured field Mirror codes
hypothesis: On MovieLens 1M explicit preference prediction, one shared table-free DHE decoder plus sixteen Givens angles for each of the user and item embedding roles will improve fresh AUC by at least 0.005 over the strongest DHE no-view, matched diagonal, or FiLM control on both seeds, remain within 0.01 AUC of full learned tables, use no more than 25% of the full-table payload, and preserve at least 80% of no-view DHE QPS.
task: Explicit rating >=4 is positive, ratings 1-3 are negative. This is binary preference prediction, not implicit-feedback or CTR reproduction.
physical_object: One shared table-free Deep Hash Embedding decoder producing 32-dimensional embeddings for both user and movie IDs from deterministic dense hash codes.
mirror_coordinate: For each of two roles (user, item), sixteen scalar angles rotate the 32-dimensional DHE output in non-overlapping 2D planes. Codes are global per role, not per ID.
logical_multiplicity: Two field-specific embedding functions recovered from one shared DHE decoder and two low-description role coordinates.

dataset.name: GroupLens MovieLens 1M
dataset.split: deterministic SHA256(user_id:movie_id) hash: 80% train, 10% development, 10% fresh audit; pairs disjoint
dataset.label: rating >=4
dataset.access_terms: Research use only; cite Harper and Konstan (2015); no redistribution; no commercial/revenue-bearing use without GroupLens permission. Archive is not committed.
dataset.citation: F. Maxwell Harper and Joseph A. Konstan. 2015. The MovieLens Datasets: History and Context. ACM TiiS 5(4), Article 19. DOI 10.1145/2827872.

prior_art_delta.DHE: PA338 uses deterministic dense hash encoding and a learned DNN to generate embeddings without embedding lookup; paper uses 1024 hash coordinates and a five-layer BN/Mish embedding network.
prior_art_delta.scoped_adaptation: CPU screen scales the hash encoding to k=128 and uses four hidden width-64 layers plus output (five linear layers total), BN and Mish. It is paper-inspired, not an official DHE reproduction.
prior_art_delta.mirror_delta: The DHE decoder is shared across user and movie fields; role-specific paired-plane rotations are added after decoder output. Compare to no-view DHE, matched paired diagonal, wider FiLM, and independent field decoders.

model.decoder: four hidden Linear(64)+BatchNorm1d+Mish blocks followed by Linear(64,32); shared across fields except independent-decoder upper control
model.recommendation_head: generalized matrix factorization: learned linear projection of elementwise user/item embedding product to one binary logit
model.optimizer: Adam, lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-6, batch=4096, CPU float32, one torch thread

controls: Independent full-cardinality user and item embedding tables
Shared table-free DHE decoder, no field code
Shared DHE decoder + sixteen paired-plane diagonal gains per role (same code bytes as Mirror)
Shared DHE decoder + per-role 32-channel FiLM scale and bias
Shared DHE decoder + per-role sixteen-angle Givens Mirror
Independent DHE decoder for user and item roles (unrestricted DHE upper control)

development.selection: Train each method through epoch 3; choose epoch {1,2,3} by mean dev logloss across both seeds.
development.tuning_boundary: Development only; no audit labels, metrics, or slice outcomes may influence settings.

fresh.training_data: Frozen 80% training partition; fresh model initialization per seed.
fresh.audit_data: Frozen 10% hash partition, pairs disjoint from train and dev.

metrics: AUC by train-only user/item frequency bins

paid_objects: full embedding tables for full control

success_gate: Both fresh seeds: shared DHE+Mirror AUC >= strongest DHE no-view/diag/FiLM AUC +0.005; AUC >= full-table AUC -0.01; complete payload <=25% full tables; p95 inference throughput >=80% of no-view DHE; for item-frequency <=5 slice with >=100 audit rows, AUC no worse than no-view DHE by >0.01.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any quality, storage, or QPS gate; or no-view/diagonal/FiLM matches Mirror within 0.005 AUC on both seeds.
not_established_gate: Archive/hash mismatch, missing registered rows, user-item leakage across splits, missing required control, or execution failure before all methods are evaluated.
boundaries: MovieLens 1M screen only; no CTR, production recommender, or official DHE reproduction claim.
Two training seeds share one deterministic audit partition; they are not independent datasets.
All ID encodings are deterministic and table-free; no per-ID learned state is added in this experiment (that is MA-1064).
Fixed epoch selection is not near-convergence or capacity evidence.
Do not redistribute the MovieLens archive or use it commercially.
